blocks.text: Asia’s Nightingale Lani Misalucha is giving back to her alma mater by way of a fundraising concert on Saturday, November 14, 2026 for its scholars and to support the school’s various initiatives. Dubbed “An evening with LA NIghtingale,” (The Nightingale), the concert will be held at the Teatro ng GSIS in Pasay City for the benefit of Saint Anthony School Singalong Alumni Association (SASSAA) and its scholars. The event will also benefit the medical and dental missions to be mounted by SASSAA Manila’s Batch ’86.
